examples.vi: Dù sở hữu khối tài sản khổng lồ, ông ấy vẫn là một người khiêm tốn và thân thiện.

thesaurus.definition: not arrogant or presuming

wiktionary.gloss: Modest and having no pretensions or ostentation.

blocks.etymology: From un- + intermittent.

wiktionary.gloss: Not intermittent.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English unsemli, probably a partial calque of Old Norse úsǽmiligr (“unseemly”); equivalent to un- + seemly. Cognate with Icelandic ósæmileg (“offensive”), Norwegian usømmelig (“unseemly”), Danish usømmelig (“unseemly”), German unziemlich.

senses.definition: Not polite, suitable, or acceptable for a particular situation.

examples.en: It would be unseemly to argue about money at a funeral.
examples.vi: Sẽ thật khiếm nhã nếu tranh cãi về tiền bạc tại một đám tang.

senses.vi: khó coi; không thích đáng; bất lịch sự

thesaurus.definition: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

vi_block: Không chỉnh, không tề chỉnh, không đoan trang.

examples: He was drunk and made some very unseemly comments.
wiktionary.gloss: Inconsistent with established standards of good form or taste.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English unsemli, probably a partial calque of Old Norse úsǽmiligr (“unseemly”); equivalent to un- + seemly. Cognate with Icelandic ósæmileg (“offensive”), Norwegian usømmelig (“unseemly”), Danish usømmelig (“unseemly”), German unziemlich.

senses.definition: In a way that is not polite, suitable, or acceptable.

examples.en: They behaved unseemly during the official ceremony.
examples.vi: Họ đã cư xử một cách khó coi trong suốt buổi lễ chính thức.

wiktionary.gloss: In an unseemly manner.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English venymous, from Old French venimos, composed of venim (“venom”) + -os (adjective-forming suffix). Synchronically analysable as venom + -ous. Compare Modern French venimeux. Piecewise doublet of venenous.

senses.definition: producing poison that can be put into another animal by biting or stinging

examples.en: Some venomous snakes can kill a person within hours.
examples.vi: Một số loài rắn độc có thể giết chết một người trong vòng vài giờ.

senses.definition: showing strong anger or cruel feelings towards someone

examples.en: She gave him a venomous look before leaving the room.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nhìn anh ta một cái nhìn cay độc trước khi rời khỏi phòng.

senses.vi: nham hiểm, độc ác; cay độc

thesaurus.definition: extremely poisonous or injurious; producing venom
marked by deep ill will; deliberately harmful

examples: Do venomous spiders have glands?
wiktionary.gloss: Of an animal (specifically a snake) or parts of its body: producing venom (“a toxin intended for defensive or offensive use”) which is usually injected into an enemy or prey by biting or stinging; hence, of a bite or sting: injecting venom.
Of or pertaining to venom.
Posing a threat; dangerous, threatening.

examples: His attitude toward me is utterly venomous.
wiktionary.gloss: Hateful; malignant; spiteful.

blocks.etymology: Blend of voice + coder.

wiktionary.gloss: Any of several electronic or digital devices or systems for the analysis or synthesis of speech.

blocks.etymology: From weightless + -ness.

thesaurus.definition: the property of being comparatively small in weight

wiktionary.gloss: The state of being free from the effects of gravity (the force).
An experience or instance of being weightless.

blocks.etymology: Bahuvrihi compound of yellow + tail

wiktionary.gloss: Having a yellow tail.

blocks.etymology: Bahuvrihi compound of yellow + tail

thesaurus.definition: superior food fish of the tropical Atlantic and Caribbean with broad yellow stripe along the sides and on the tail
game fish of southern California and Mexico having a yellow tail fin

Japanese amberjack (Seriola quinqueradiata), native to the northwest Pacific, often used in sushi, .

yellowtail flounder (Limanda ferruginea).
